function.name: http_get
function.description: Fetch a URL with an HTTP GET request and return the status and body.

headers.description: Optional HTTP request headers as a JSON object.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web and return the top results.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file (or list a directory) in your working directory.

path.description: Absolute path of the file or directory.

function.name: wait_and_retry
function.description: Wait the given number of seconds, then fetch the URL again.

url.description: The URL to fetch after waiting.

seconds.description: How long to wait before retrying (for example the Retry-After value).

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run a short Python snippet in a sandbox and return its output.

code.description: The Python source code to run.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Send a question or status update to the user who gave you the task.

question.description: What you need from the user, or why you are stuck.
